{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
# Remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
df_clean = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of customers in the cleaned data
mean_age = df_clean['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age"}
